scope: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B BF16 TP2 FULL graph, same decode batch, routed-expert GroupedMatmul and GDN vector work; no microbatch split, stale hidden states, model rewrite, quantization, kernel replacement or manifest change
shape_policy: Read M/K/N, expert counts, phase and callsite from retained kernel_details and model callsites. Missing expert counts/weight format or saturated concurrency must remain explicit gaps; the single-request baseline is not saturated evidence and cannot support performance acceptance.

arms.A: Native serial execution, no new carrier, same inputs/weights/cache/seed/graph buckets and existing carriers.
arms.B: Only if independent branches are proved: default-off dual-stream scheduling of the same GMM and GDN operations with one fixed AIC/AIV quota pair. Event producer/consumer ordering and tensor lifetime must be preserved. No quota sweep. Quotas must be derived from a2 capacity and supported graph APIs before device execution.

static_gate: First establish whether same-batch GDN and routed GMM are data independent. A serial producer-consumer chain stops this implementation before L0; an unrelated-input synthetic overlap is not serving evidence. Unknown host structure also stops, without claiming absence of all possible overlap.

criteria.correctness: L0 tensor checks plus independent plain opt bench l3 A/B and opt bench compare PASS, greedy temperature=0 seed=42; any mismatch stops advancement and preserves default-off.
criteria.mechanism: Paired target device intervals: overlap fraction = intersection duration / min(GMM duration, GDN duration) >= 0.5, not merely distinct stream IDs; supported core quotas sum within a2 capacity, no resource-contention tail.
criteria.graph_performance: Same shape/weight/carrier facts, three repeats and medians: paired critical path decreases and plain L1/L2 show improvement without regression. L4 all-kernel operator counts/time remain recorded. No graph result is an operator-level acceptance claim. Do not consume deprecated free_attribution v1 fields.
criteria.acceptance: No accepted state with missing shape/expert-count/saturation facts, failed L3, unsupported graph synchronization/core limiting, or unresolved coverage FAIL. Static evidence alone is not numerical or performance validation.

stop_conditions: Same-batch producer-consumer dependency or hidden dependency: stop before stream implementation and record blocked with exact callsites.
Missing independent branches or unsupported FULL-graph synchronization/core-limiting contract: stop, do not substitute eager evidence.
Numerical mismatch, graph hang, overlap fraction < 0.5 or critical-path non-improvement: no promotion, preserve failure evidence.
Arm shape/weight/carrier mismatch, environment guard rejection, quota totals beyond capacity, or budget exhausted: stop; no guard bypass, no unplanned window.
No push, repin, manifest activation, cross-branch checkout, or reopening rejected methods.

budget.device_execution_condition: Static independence, exact shape facts and supported fixed quotas must be declared in a new append-only execution receipt before spending device budget. If static gate blocks, serve starts and NPU measurement time remain zero.

existing_blocker.action: Keep FAIL visible; no repin; does not prevent static investigation.
